totalCount = 0
index = 0
mode = 0

if characters[0] == '_':
    mode = 0
elif characters[0] == '(':
    mode = 1

for i in range(n):
    if mode == 0:
        if characters[i] == '_':
            index += 1
        else:
            if characters[i] != '(':
                counts[index] += 1
            elif characters[i] == '(':
                mode = 1
            elif characters[i] == ')':

    else:
        if characters[i] == ')':
            mode = 0
            index += 1
        elif i > 0:
            if characters[i - 1] == '(' or characters[i - 1] == '_':
                if characters[i] != '_' and characters[i] != '(':
                    totalCount += 1

# Bubble sort
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i, 0, -1):
        if counts[j] > counts[j - 1]:
            counts[j], counts[j - 1] = counts[j - 1], counts[j]

print(counts[0])
print(totalCount)
